summary: Frontend-only validation of OMNIA logo placement across the ecosystem (auth pages, public landing, agency shell, widget iframes, direct assets). All 7 acceptance criteria pass: mark logo visible on /it/login, /it/register, /it/forgot-password; full logo 120px xl on /it landing hero + mini mark in footer next to '© 2026 OMNIA Real Estate Lab'; agency shell sidebar shows mark at top-left; agency-branded dashboard pages (/it/app/dashboard, /properties, /clients) contain NO OMNIA full logo in main content (White Label D-041 respected — only sidebar mark); widget iframes (staging.html + legal.html) show mini-logo before 'Powered by OMNIA'; direct assets (/omnia-logo.png, /omnia-mark.png, /favicon.png) return HTTP 200 with content-type image/png.

issues: Sidebar in current build renders on light/white background (not the navy #0B1E3F described in the request). The OmniaLogo mark is present but not visually 'inverted white-on-navy' — it stays as black-on-white. Either the sidebar theme was intentionally lightened, or the `inverted` prop is not being applied. Verify design intent: if sidebar should be dark, restore navy background and set `inverted={true}` on the mark; if it should be light, update the acceptance criteria wording.

Acceptance criteria mentions data-testid='landing-hero-logo' (wrapper), but only 'omnia-logo-full' is present on the img itself. Not blocking (the full logo IS visible at 120px), but if the wrapper testid is needed for targeting the hero region in tests, add it to the parent element.

action_items: Confirm sidebar background intent (dark navy vs light) — screenshots show a light/white sidebar, not the navy described in the request. If dark is desired, restore bg + pass `inverted` prop to OmniaLogo.
(Optional) add data-testid='landing-hero-logo' wrapper on the hero logo container in LandingApp.jsx to match the spec testid list.
critical_code_review_comments: OmniaLogo.jsx is clean, small (49 lines), uses data-testid dynamically (omnia-logo-mark / omnia-logo-full) — good.
White Label D-041 constraint enforced correctly: no `<OmniaLogo>` full renders in dashboard/properties/clients main content (verified via DOM query returning 0 omnia-logo-full nodes).

Widget iframes are served from /api/widgets/v1/*.html and embed in the powered-by footer. Only two cosmetic notes: (1) sidebar in AgencyShell currently light — verify with product owner if it should be dark navy; (2) landing-hero-logo wrapper testid missing (omnia-logo-full is present on the img itself). No blockers.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues. Two minor cosmetic/spec deviations documented above.
